description:
The Flight Crew View app is currently running. You need to simulate a troubleshooting step by performing a 'Force Stop' on the application through the Android System Settings, and then relaunching it.

1. Navigate to Android Settings > Apps > Flight Crew View.
2. Tap 'Force Stop' and confirm the action.
3. Verify the app process is terminated (Force Stop button becomes disabled).
4. Return to the home screen and relaunch Flight Crew View.
5. Ensure the app opens successfully to the main screen.
